description: This Kotlin source file defines ContentRowAdapter, an adapter for a RecyclerView that displays a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontal list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure the row title remains visible when a card inside the row gains focus.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: An adapter inheriting from ListAdapter to handle displaying a list of ContentRow objects, managing diffing logic and view creation/binding.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for a single row, managing the title TextView and inner RecyclerView of content cards.

methods.name: ContentRowAdapter
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a list of ContentRow objects and submits the list to the superclass.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_content_row layout to create a new RowVH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow object to the ViewHolder.
